lines.speaker: cielo
lines.text: Annihilio has been intercepted! It's falling!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Hahaha! Fall! Crash and burn! Don't you dare show your face in the skies ever again!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: It's not crashing. It's accelerating...

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Not on my watch! We're descending too!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: We're practically in freefall now. The hull won't hold!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: It has to! This is Zoomie's debut fight!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Annihilio is accelerating!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: We've gotta jump!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: All right, let's go! We'll figure it out!

lines.speaker: mustang_op
lines.text: Stop.

lines.speaker: mustang_op
lines.text: Leave it to les héros.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: It's coming down! Prepare to intercept!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: My body's overheating!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: We need to cool down!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Argh...! We've been pushing ourselves too hard...!
Maxwell looks up at the sky. Annihilio is quickly approaching.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: This is gonna be cutting it close...!
Ark Leon rushes forward and takes position at where the missile's headed.

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: I'll stop it! You handle the rest!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Are you insane?! You're gonna stop that thing barehanded...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Agh...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... All right! We're counting on you!

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: Leave it to me!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Emergency cooling! Hurry!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hoo! Hoo!

lines.speaker: red_op_l
lines.text: She's overdoing it again!

lines.speaker: blue_op_r
lines.text: She always does!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Red! Blue!

lines.speaker: red_op_l
lines.text: We're here!

lines.speaker: blue_op_r
lines.text: Let's do this, heroes!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: You came...

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Let's do this!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Ark Lander and Ark Falcon have joined Ark Leon!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Excellente.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Um... B-by the way...

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: I, uh, might be jumping to conclusions,

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: but are the three Ark Machines actually going to...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui. You are correct in your thinking.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: When the three Ark Machines all connectent,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: the true power of the Ark Machines is unleashed.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Wow... Oooh wow...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Ark Rangers,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: combine!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Hnnngh!
Th-that's insane! They're combining!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What is that thing? Tetra made that...?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Amazing.

lines.speaker: sky_op_r
lines.text: Argh! They're stealing the spotlight!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: Yeah, but it's fine. A win's a win.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Zoomie's debut fight has been a resounding success ★

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: How is that even possible? It's insane...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... Before you say anything, we're not going to be getting a Matis Machine or anything.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: What? Why not?!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: If you don't give me a robot right now, I'm going on strike!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Ah... I can die happy now...

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Energy signature detected in the explosion!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Quoi?!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: It's heading for the Ark Buster!
Something comes rushing out from the plumes of smoke.
On its back, it carries a sphere formed by dozens of Seven Dwarves I units,
and charges straight at the Ark Buster.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: What...?!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: That must be its true form...!

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Defend!

lines.speaker: annihilio
lines.text: Kekeke!
Annihilio lets out a disturbing laugh unlike anything in this world.
Light emits from its vast array of gun barrels.
*Bam, bam, bam!*
A barrage of bullets pounds the Ark Buster.
Its armor shatters as it staggers backward.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Agh! It's targeting the power core!

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: The cockpit's about to give out!
*Bam, bam, bam!*
The relentless barrage continues. Annihilio closes in further on the Ark Buster.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: We can't take much more...!
Deafening blasts of noise ring in the cockpit.
The entrance to the cockpit starts to break apart.
*Bam, bam, bam!*

lines.speaker: annihilio
lines.text: Kekeke!
Part of the cockpit entrance falls off while light and smoke begin to seep inside.
Ark Ranger Black looks back at Red and Blue standing behind her.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... Let's go.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Time to be heroes beyond the screen.

lines.speaker: annihilio
lines.text: Kekeke!
Annihilio's fusillade continues unabated, accompanied by its grotesque laughter.
The Ark Buster's cockpit begins to collapse.
*Bam, bam, bam!*

lines.speaker: annihilio
lines.text: Kekeke!!
The cockpit finally gives way.
Just then,
Annihilio sees the three heroes leap out from the shattered cockpit.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Ultimate attack! Ark Black Meteor!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Finishing move! Ark Red Crash!

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Secret technique! Ark Blue Typhoon!!
In that instant, Annihilio's body flashes brilliantly.
Golden beams, crimson lightning, and a colorless shockwave slam into it.
Annihilio staggers.
The Ark Rangers rush forward,
toward its core.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: As long as we have courage!

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: We...

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: are unstoppable!
*Boom!*
The Ark Rangers land on the ground.
They do not look behind them,
because they already know they've won.
The enemy falls.
*Booooom!*
A massive explosion engulfs the area.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Red.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: It's time to say our victory slogan.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: The Ark Rangers...

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: will always protect the Ark!
OPERATION CRIMSON SKY: COMPLETE
Ark Ranger Black turns around.
She sees the three members of Matis watching her from atop a building.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: That's Matis...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Oh, she's looking this way.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You should at least acknowledge her. She's staring right at us.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Tell her to stop. It's making me uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Are you not going to say hi, Laplace?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: No, there's no need.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: We've already said enough to each other.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: When...? You've never even really met.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Let's go. We're returning to the Ark.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I'm not used to you being this serious.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I don't like it.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Heading out already? That's a shame ★
We have to get to something urgent.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: The Wings of Victory sure was incredible, wasn't it?
Yeah, it was amazing. So were the Ark Rangers.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Hehe ★

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Now that our brilliant debut is over, we've got to start preparing for what comes next.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: There's a huge battle waiting for us in the not-so-distant future, right?
Hm...

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Hehe, you can't really say anything because it's classified, huh? Sorry for asking ♥

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: When the time comes, I hope you'll be our captain again, Captain.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Anyway, good luck with your mission ♥
Thanks. You all did great out there. See you next time.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Hehe! ♥

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You two seem to get along well.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah, you get this dumb smile on your face whenever you talk to that flight attendant.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Are we really heading straight to Eden without any rest?
We've been delayed too much already. We don't have time to rest.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: Can you hear me?
Ingrid.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Instructor.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Boss.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Tactical Boss.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: ... I'd appreciate it if you all picked one name for me and stuck with it.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: I have something to discuss regarding the Heretic Annihilio.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: It appears it is not a single entity.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: I checked the point of interception and confirmed it vanished without a trace when it exploded.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: In other words, it was nothing more than a missile.
... A missile made of nanomachines.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: Correct. It is highly unlikely they would produce only one of them, so it is reasonable to assume they have more.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: There is little I can think of that would be more dangerous than having dozens of those plummeting toward the Ark at once.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: Victory would be far from a guarantee.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: Enikk traced the heat source and found it was launched near the Lift.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: The situation there seems to be quiet for now, but we have no way of knowing when the next attack will commence.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: Having said all that, don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: We've reinforced the anti-air defense network,

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: and both the Wings of Victory Elysion Edition and the Ark Rangers are on constant standby.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: We should be able to defend against any worst-case scenario.
Okay. We're counting on you.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: ... At this point,

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: we can't afford to delay the Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: ... You've done well. We'll meet again.
Likewise. See you next time.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What a mess.
Oh, wait. Another transmission is coming in.

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: Hi there, Counters.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ooh! It's Ark Ranger Black!

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: This operation wouldn't have succeeded without you.

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: I wanted to sincerely thank you for all your help.
You're the ones who did the heavy lifting.
You were amazing. I was really moved.

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: ... That's kind of you to say. Thank you.

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: I hope someday we can fight together again on the Ark's behalf.
Same here.

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: Also, Anis.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Huh? Me?

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: Good luck on your next mission. See you around.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Between the Heretic, the giant robots, and the Wings of Victory, this was quite the chaotic mission.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It does feel like a weight's been lifted, though, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah, it does.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Knowing there are this many Nikkes protecting the Ark is reassuring.
Yeah. The Ark is safe.
... For now, at least.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Agreed. This is the first time it's been targeted this directly.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: It'll probably only get worse from here.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: And we won't be able to hold out forever.
Which is why we need to hurry.
We need to move as quickly as possible...
and take down the Queen.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Agreed.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: All right. Let's keep pushing forward.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Let's do it! Firepower, go go!
Yeah, let's go.
